findings.evidenceJa: 空は薄墨に染まっていた
findings.governingReading: The sky is dyed the pale gray-black of diluted ink.
findings.explanation: Thin is not a color and removes the ink-wash atmosphere.

findings.highlight: a battle she once went through
findings.evidenceJa: 彼女が駆け抜けた戦場
findings.governingReading: This is one of the battlefields across which she once raced.
findings.explanation: Battle replaces battlefield and went through loses the mounted speed and spatial traversal.

findings.evidenceJa: 今は従える騎兵もない
findings.governingReading: Now she has no cavalry under her command.
findings.explanation: Alongside removes the relation of command and obedience.

findings.highlight: The remains of battle, which she is well-accustomed to.
findings.evidenceJa: とうに見慣れた、戦場跡にすぎなかった
findings.governingReading: What spreads before her is merely the long-familiar remains of a battlefield.
findings.explanation: The English is a sentence fragment and “remains of battle” weakens the ruined place.

findings.evidenceJa: 感情が湧き立たない
findings.governingReading: No emotion wells up in the observing consciousness at this sight.
findings.explanation: The English turns absence of an arising response into total absence of emotion.

findings.evidenceJa: 討ち滅ぼした兵士の骸
findings.governingReading: She glances over the corpses of soldiers she annihilated.
findings.explanation: Defeated suppresses both her agency and the total killing expressed by 討ち滅ぼした.

findings.highlight: becoming a feudal lord like her father
findings.evidenceJa: 父に代わって領主となった
findings.governingReading: She became lord in her father’s place.
findings.explanation: Like her father changes succession and substitution into resemblance.

findings.highlight: Of course, such things were not a problem.
findings.evidenceJa: 事実、王は無敵だった
findings.governingReading: The active Japanese begins directly by stating that the king was in fact invincible.
findings.explanation: mirror moon conditionally inserts an unsupported broad dismissal of the preceding concerns before the active narration.

findings.evidenceJa: 騎馬形式
findings.governingReading: The surface text names a cavalry formation while the ruby specifies Cataphract.
findings.explanation: Cavalry keeps only a generic concept and loses the formation-plus-specialized-name layering.

findings.evidenceJa: 異民族の歩兵
findings.governingReading: Her army defeats the infantry of other ethnic groups.
findings.explanation: Infantry is an uncountable collective noun here; infantries is malformed English.

findings.highlight: had to defeat all her enemies
findings.evidenceJa: 全ての敵を切り捨てねばならなかった
findings.governingReading: Once she went to war, she had to cut down and discard every enemy.
findings.explanation: Defeat softens the repeated lethal “cut away” relation that mirrors her sacrifice of subjects.

findings.highlight: there could not be any knights that killed more people than her
findings.evidenceJa: 彼女ほど多くの人間を殺めた騎士はいなかっただろう
findings.governingReading: There was likely no knight who had killed as many human beings as she had.
findings.explanation: Could not converts the narrator’s だろう inference into categorical impossibility.

findings.evidenceJa: 幾つもの部族を乱れなく統率し
findings.governingReading: The king brings several tribes under orderly command.
findings.explanation: The people erases the multiplicity and tribal political units being governed.

findings.highlight: the fair king honored by her knights isolated herself.
findings.evidenceJa: 王は、そうして孤立していった
findings.governingReading: The admired king grows increasingly isolated as others withdraw and distrust her.
findings.explanation: Isolated herself assigns the social outcome to her deliberate agency.

findings.evidenceJa: 是非もない
findings.governingReading: The king treats abandonment, fear, and betrayal as unavoidable matters beyond remedy.
findings.explanation: No right or wrong mistakes the idiom for a moral judgment.

findings.highlight: She had so many people around her
findings.evidenceJa: あんなに雁首そろえておいて
findings.governingReading: Shirou angrily pictures all those people gathered together by their heads, yet none told Saber the truth.
findings.explanation: Many people removes the contemptuous bodily image carrying his anger at the court.

findings.evidenceJa: イリヤの森から出て
findings.governingReading: They came out of Illya’s forest and returned home.
findings.explanation: Escaped adds a successful flight framing absent from this temporal recap.

findings.evidenceJa: セイバーが正座していた
findings.governingReading: Saber is seated in formal seiza beside Shirou’s pillow.
findings.explanation: Japanese-style again replaces a precise posture with a vague cultural label.

findings.highlight: I did it with Saber because I’m her Master.
findings.evidenceJa: セイバーと触れあったのはあくまでマスターとしてだ
findings.governingReading: Shirou insists that his physical contact with Saber that night occurred strictly in his role as Master.
findings.explanation: One English branch uses the sexually suggestive “did it with” and erases the actual contact.

findings.evidenceJa: 遠坂のヤツが、あんなコトするから
findings.governingReading: The entire page comparing Rin and warning against becoming conscious of her is commented out in the Japanese script.
findings.explanation: mirror moon activates the deleted page as an English-only source-variant insertion.

findings.highlight: we haven’t eaten since yesterday afternoon
findings.evidenceJa: 昨日の昼から何も食べていないセイバー
findings.governingReading: Saber has eaten nothing since noon the previous day.
findings.explanation: Afternoon delays the starting point and we incorrectly includes Shirou in the fasting interval.

findings.evidenceJa: みんなまだ寝てるんだろ
findings.governingReading: Shirou infers that everyone else is probably still asleep.
findings.explanation: Should sleep changes an inference about their present state into a recommendation.

findings.evidenceJa: 付け焼き刃の鍛錬
findings.governingReading: They continued improvised, makeshift training because a superior common enemy targeted them.
findings.explanation: The English removes the provisional quality and turns the shared continued practice into Shirou training alone.

findings.highlight: That’s a big help for me when I talk to you.
findings.evidenceJa: その方が、俺も話してて楽だ
findings.governingReading: Shirou first says talking is 楽, then clarifies that he means 楽しい—fun—rather than merely easy.
findings.explanation: Big help does not share the word needed for his immediate playful self-correction to fun.

findings.evidenceJa: ねぎ、しめじ
findings.governingReading: Shirou takes green onion and shimeji mushrooms in addition to the other ingredients.
findings.explanation: The English omits the green onion and generalizes shimeji while using ordinary onion for the separately listed 玉ねぎ.
